# EventBridge Pipes

Connect SQS queues and Kinesis or DynamoDB streams to targets with filtering and Lambda enrichment.

**Status: implemented subset.** Operation selection does not imply complete input or behavior parity.

| Contract | Current implementation |
| --- | --- |
| Service ID | `pipes` |
| Signing name | `pipes` |
| Wire protocol | REST JSON |
| API version | `2015-10-07` |
| Scope | Account and region |
| Execution | Local behavior |
| Selected operations | 10 of 10 in the pinned model |

## Implemented behavior

See the [implemented feature catalogue](catalogue.md#eventbridge-pipes) for this service's capabilities.

## Limitations and future work

- MQ, Kafka, MSK and other sources, and ECS, Batch, Firehose, HTTP and other targets fail CreatePipe explicitly.
- No batching windows, parallelization, dead-letter queues, retry limits or partial batch failure handling; a failed delivery is retried on the next visit.
- AT_TIMESTAMP starting positions, log configuration and KMS keys are not supported.
- Only Lambda enrichments; API destination and HTTP enrichment parameters are not supported.
- JSON paths in EventBridge target parameters and [*] wildcards in templates are not supported.
- Role ARNs are checked for shape only; IAM policies are not evaluated.
- Deliveries to queues, topics and functions use the service's role in AWS and are not checked against the target's resource policy.

These gaps describe current boundaries and possible follow-up slices. The [roadmap](../roadmap/index.md)
separates proposed work from registered functionality; there are no promised release dates.

## Supported operations

The table is generated from the profile and pinned Smithy model. Routes show REST bindings or the standard
JSON/Query endpoint. RPC v2 CBOR uses its service/operation route, as described in
[protocol handling](../architecture/request-flow.md). Supported members are selected separately in the
[shape whitelist](https://github.com/amjadjibon/tinystack/blob/main/generator/model/profile.json); an enabled operation may reject unsupported options.

| Operation | HTTP binding |
| --- | --- |
| `CreatePipe` | `POST /v1/pipes/{Name}` |
| `DeletePipe` | `DELETE /v1/pipes/{Name}` |
| `DescribePipe` | `GET /v1/pipes/{Name}` |
| `ListPipes` | `GET /v1/pipes` |
| `ListTagsForResource` | `GET /tags/{resourceArn}` |
| `StartPipe` | `POST /v1/pipes/{Name}/start` |
| `StopPipe` | `POST /v1/pipes/{Name}/stop` |
| `TagResource` | `POST /tags/{resourceArn}` |
| `UntagResource` | `DELETE /tags/{resourceArn}` |
| `UpdatePipe` | `PUT /v1/pipes/{Name}` |
